Counting trains, segment by segment

The line width represents scheduled passenger train journeys across a corridor, summed in both directions and divided by the number of selected service days. These are trains, not passengers or seats.

Coverage

Dates follow the feed’s local service days. An overnight train belongs to its departure service day. This is a timetable snapshot, not a count of trains that actually ran; short-notice changes and cancellations are not applied.
